name: The Champion's Training

start.dialog: Need a training opponent! Someone TOUGH! Bring me a SAND WYRM! ALIVE! I'll wrestle it! For TRAINING! The big ones lurk in the Shifting Dunes! Reward? WORTH it!
start.objective: Capture a live sand wyrm from the Shifting Dunes

progress.dialog: Where's my WYRM? The CHAMPION waits! Big one! ANGRY one! I need a CHALLENGE, not a pet!
progress.objective: Continue hunting for a large, aggressive sand wyrm

complete.dialog: MAGNIFICENT! The WRESTLE! The THRILL! That wyrm had SPIRIT! Here! My SIGNATURE move! The SCORCHING SUPLEX! Learn it! Use it! CONQUER with it!

party_comments.kade: Oh man, I loved watching the fights back home!
party_comments.twist: CAN I BE YOUR MANAGER?! PLEASE?!

hidden_outcome: If you bring a wyrm larger than 20 feet, El Scorcho names his new move after you: '[PlayerName] Crusher'
